strategyOwner: Fadil Lubis / GTMx outbound (Stephanie Izzi thread)
headline: Your Growbots waterfall journey.
subheadline: One routed cascade that finds B2B SMBs already paying for outbound the hard way, and hands each one the Growbots Concierge or platform offer that fits how they run pipeline today.
productSummary: Growbots (growbots.com) is an AI-powered outbound sales platform and Concierge lead-generation service for small and mid-size B2B companies. Site positioning: seek, pick, and reach ideal decision-makers, or let Concierge manage outbound end-to-end. Published capabilities: 180M+ verified contacts database plus custom crawlers; custom outreach plans drawn from 150,000+ past campaigns and 300M+ emails sent; email and LinkedIn campaign execution with a dedicated writer, sales rep, and AI specialist; deliverability management claiming 95% inbox placement; CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce); Self-Service, Concierge, and Premium Support modes. Public proof language on growbots.com: 3,000+ customers served, $500M+ revenue generated for customers, 11+ years in business, work across 50+ B2B industries (IT/SaaS/security, professional services & talent, industrial & logistics, agencies & creative, finance/legal/accounting). Stephanie Izzi is Vice President, Sales & Client Success (stephanie@growbots.com).
coreInsight: Stephanie sells one Growbots outbound engine for SMBs, not a different product per industry vertical. Industry and title are merge tags after routing. The single routing signal is outbound_mode: how a lead source already shows the company generating pipeline today (hiring SDRs, running a DIY sequencer stack, sitting on recent funding with no outbound team, or none of those). That ladder maps to Growbots' live offers: Concierge replaces headcount, Concierge replaces the DIY stack, Concierge turns funding into booked meetings, then a soft remaining-TAM pipeline playbook.

signalReasons: An open SDR, BDR, or outbound AE role means the company is already budgeting headcount to create pipeline. That is the strongest, most time-bound intent for Concierge replacement.

DIY sequencer stacks (Instantly, Lemlist, Smartlead, Apollo sequences, Mailshake, Woodpecker) show up in BuiltWith, job posts, and careers pages, so the pain of list building, copy, and deliverability is observable without paid enrichment.
A recent Crunchbase funding round with no SDR hire and no sequencer stack is a public growth bet that still needs meetings. Concierge turns that capital into a booked calendar.
All three signals ride on free or cheap sources (LinkedIn Jobs / Indeed, BuiltWith, Crunchbase / Apollo firmographics), so the TAM and the routing signal come in the same pull.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: SDR headcount
tiers.trigger: B2B SMB posted an SDR, BDR, outbound AE, or sales-development role in the last 60 days (LinkedIn Jobs / Indeed).
tiers.pain: They are adding headcount just to keep the calendar full. Every SDR hire is salary, ramp, tools, and deliverability risk before the first qualified meeting.
tiers.valueProp: Growbots Concierge puts a five-person outbound team (strategist, researcher, copywriter, deliverability, RevOps) on the account so founders review and close instead of hiring and managing (growbots.com).

tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + Indeed scrape matched to Apollo firmographics

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: DIY sequencer stack
tiers.trigger: BuiltWith or careers/tech page shows Instantly, Lemlist, Smartlead, Apollo sequences, Outreach, Salesloft, Mailshake, Woodpecker, or Reply.io.
tiers.pain: They already pay for a sequencer and still own prospecting, copy, deliverability, and reply handling. The tool did not remove the ops load.
tiers.valueProp: Growbots runs list building from 180M+ verified contacts, copy, sends, and deliverability (95% inbox placement claim) under one Concierge team, with domains and inboxes included (growbots.com).
tiers.magnet: {{diy_tool}}-to-Concierge teardown: what stays in their CRM vs what Growbots owns
tiers.dataSource: BuiltWith + careers/tech-stack scrape matched to Apollo
tiers.replyDensity: High. Named stack, clear ops pain (estimate)

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Post-funding pipeline gap
tiers.trigger: Crunchbase funding in the last 12 months and no SDR hire and no DIY sequencer detected.
tiers.pain: The round bought product and headcount plans, not a filled calendar. Pipeline still depends on founder-led outbound that does not scale.
tiers.valueProp: Growbots Concierge launches a custom outreach plan from 150,000+ past campaigns in ~2 weeks so the round turns into qualified meetings without a 2-3 month SDR hire (growbots.com).
tiers.magnet: Post-{{funding_round}} pipeline brief: 3 segments Growbots would run first in {{industry}}
tiers.dataSource: Crunchbase funding feed joined to Apollo, minus Tier 1 and Tier 2 matches
tiers.replyDensity: Medium. Money in the bank, softer urgency (estimate)

tiers.valueProp: Growbots has run outbound for 3,000+ customers across 50+ B2B industries with an all-inclusive Concierge model (growbots.com).

launchPlan: Pull the TAM: Apollo / Sales Nav B2B companies roughly 5-200 employees in Growbots' published industry clusters (IT/SaaS/security, professional services & talent, industrial & logistics, agencies & creative, finance/legal/accounting).
Enrich once: 60-day LinkedIn/Indeed SDR job scrape, BuiltWith + careers scrape for DIY sequencer tools, Crunchbase funding in the last 12 months, Growbots customer exclusion list.
Run the routing agent top to bottom: exclusions, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, catch-all. Assert every account exits with exactly one tier.
Find contacts per account via Apollo / Sales Navigator: Head of Sales or Founder first, RevOps second (for the Day 7 'you or {{alt_decision_maker}}' line).
Have Growbots approve the four offers (worksheet, DIY teardown, funding brief, playbook) and every proof line before sends start.
Launch only tiers with ~1,500+ contacts. Tier 1 accumulates weekly; until it clears ~1,500, send new SDR-hiring rows through Tier 2 copy.
Review reply math per tier after 1,500 sends, scale or cut per thresholds, then keep adding Apollo accounts without rebuilding the strategy.
